target.title: fix(plugins): pretag pack checks stop hanging on stalled commands
target.body:
## What Problem This Solves

Fixes an issue where the fast plugin pretag check could return after timing out a stalled build or pack command while bash/npm descendant processes remained alive and continued touching the release checkout.

## Why This Change Was Made

Pretag runtime-build, npm-pack, and ClawHub-pack commands now run through the existing managed process owner instead of `execFileSync`. The shared owner already provides detached POSIX process groups, Windows task-tree termination, signal forwarding, and joined child shutdown, so it can enforce the existing 10-minute per-command ceiling across the entire process tree.

Timeout errors still identify only the failed release stage and safe command label. Direct binary execution, environment/stdio behavior, serial stage ordering, nonzero exit failures, and the existing 600,000 ms default budget are preserved.

## User Impact

Plugin release preflight now stops the full stalled process tree and exits with an actionable stage-specific timeout instead of leaving orphaned build or pack descendants behind. Successful builds and packs retain their existing behavior and per-command budget.

## Evidence

Validated on exact head `dd256dd70effd9dd65469549a071a283cb9d3aac`.

### Process-tree runtime proof

A temporary publishable plugin exercised the real pretag orchestration. Its npm-pack script spawned a long-lived Node descendant and then stalled. The bounded run returned the expected sanitized error, and both the direct bash process and descendant were gone before the check settled:

```text
npm pack: @openclaw/proof-plugin
{"timeoutCode":"ETIMEDOUT","message":"npm pack for @openclaw/proof-plugin timed out after 750ms: bash scripts/plugin-npm-publish.sh --pack-dry-run extensions/proof-plugin","elapsedWithinBound":true,"directExited":true,"descendantExited":true}
```

### Automated validation

- Plugin test coverage: `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/plugin-release-pretag-pack-check.test.ts test/scripts/managed-child-process.test.ts` — 2 files, 15 tests passed.
- `node scripts/run-vitest.mjs test/scripts/package-acceptance-workflow.test.ts -t "keeps beta release verification and ClawHub publish repair hooks wired"` — passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:scripts` — passed.
- `pnpm tsgo:test:root` — passed.
- `pnpm check:script-declarations` — passed.
- `pnpm format:check --no-error-on-unmatched-pattern -- scripts/lib/managed-child-process.d.mts scripts/lib/managed-child-process.mjs scripts/plugin-release-pretag-pack-check.ts test/scripts/managed-child-process.test.ts test/scripts/plugin-release-pretag-pack-check.test.ts` — passed.
- Targeted Oxlint for `scripts/lib/managed-child-process.mjs` and `scripts/plugin-release-pretag-pack-check.ts` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed.
